To this effect, we are building a line of business Vi Finance to offer Financial services & payments proposition. This will work under a partnership model, wherein we will bring in credible players in the space of lending and investments to offer Personal loan, Credit cards, Fixed deposits etc. to our customers. Given this is a priority, there is a need to get a techno commercial individual leading this agenda for us. Proposal We propose to bring on board a category lead for managing the financial services & payments business. The primary responsibility of this individual would be to manage and scale this business for us. This would mean that the incumbent will have to recruit partners across every category, evolve the user experience, drive the GTM, keep sharing market insights with the leadership, recommend a future roadmap and grow the portfolio as per annual operational plan. The key metric that this role is expected to deliver is – incremental revenue, scale adoption and keep pace with best in class Apps competing in this space. Utilize analytics-driven decision-making, customer segmentation, and funnel improvement strategies to scale user adoption, transactions and disbursements Take full ownership of driving significant revenue growth and GMV expansion across payment and Other mobile recharge categories. Drive Utility Payments like Electricity, Gas bills, Credit card bill payments, Fastag recharges, other mobile operator recharges etc. New Partnerships & Business Development: Drive strategic partnerships with credible players in Financial services & Payments ecosystem. title: Marketing Head
description:
Job Purpose: The Marketing Head is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to strengthen Kidzonia International Preschool & Day Care's brand presence, drive admissions, enhance parent engagement, and support business growth across all centers. This role oversees digital marketing, offline marketing, lead generation, events, partnerships, center branding, and marketing team performance while ensuring consistent communication of Kidzonia's values and educational philosophy.Travel to centers is mandatory to monitor marketing activities, support admissions initiatives, conduct market assessments, and ensure consistent brand implementation across all locations.
 Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Marketing Planning Develop and implement annual and quarterly marketing strategies aligned with organizational goals. Create admission-focused marketing plans to support enrollment targets. Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and competitive positioning strategies. Develop center-specific marketing initiatives based on local demographics and market conditions. Establish marketing budgets and monitor return on investment (ROI). 2. Brand Management Strengthen and maintain Kidzonia's brand identity across all centers. Ensure consistency in branding, messaging, and communication materials. Develop brand guidelines and monitor compliance across locations. Build brand awareness and credibility within target communities. Enhance Kidzonia's reputation as a trusted preschool and daycare provider. 3. Admissions & Lead Generation Design and execute lead generation campaigns to increase admissions inquiries. Monitor lead conversion funnels and optimize marketing efforts. Collaborate with Center Managers and Admissions Teams to improve conversion rates. Track admission targets and marketing performance across centers. Develop promotional campaigns during admission seasons. 4. Digital Marketing Oversee digital marketing initiatives including: Social Media Marketing Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Google Ads Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Campaigns Email Marketing WhatsApp Marketing Website Management Monitor campaign performance and optimize digital spending. Ensure regular publication of engaging and child-friendly content. Analyze digital metrics and prepare performance reports. 5. Content Development & Communication Develop marketing content including: Brochures Flyers Newsletters Website Content Social Media Posts Admission Campaign Materials Parent Communication Materials Ensure all content aligns with Kidzonia's educational philosophy and values. Coordinate professional photography and videography activities. Manage content calendars and campaign schedules. 6. Events & Community Outreach Plan and execute: Open House Events Admission Drives Parent Engagement Programs Annual Functions Summer Camp Promotions Community Events Build relationships with local communities, residential societies, and corporate organizations. Organize promotional activities to increase visibility and admissions. Support centers in executing local marketing initiatives. 7. Center Marketing Support Conduct regular visits to centers to assess marketing effectiveness. Support Center Managers in local marketing activities. Ensure proper implementation of marketing campaigns at center level. Monitor display materials, branding elements, and promotional activities. Identify opportunities to improve center visibility and parent engagement. 8. Partnership & Business Development Develop strategic partnerships with: Residential Communities Corporate Organizations Pediatric Clinics Educational Institutions Parenting Groups Community Organizations Explore tie-ups that support brand awareness and admissions growth. Negotiate and manage marketing partnerships and sponsorship opportunities. 9. Marketing Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop the marketing team. Define roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations. Monitor team productivity and campaign execution. Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide coaching. Foster innovation and creativity within the marketing function. 10. Budget Management & Vendor Coordination Prepare and manage the marketing budget. Monitor campaign expenses and vendor payments. Coordinate with agencies, designers, printers, digital marketing partners, and event vendors. Negotiate contracts and ensure cost-effective utilization of resources. Track marketing ROI and spending efficiency. 11. Market Research & Competitive Analysis Conduct market research to understand customer needs and industry trends. Monitor competitor activities, offerings, and marketing strategies. Analyze parent feedback and market perceptions. Recommend improvements based on market intelligence and insights. 12. Reporting & Analytics Prepare periodic reports on: Lead Generation Admissions Conversion Campaign Performance Digital Metrics Brand Reach Marketing ROI Present insights and recommendations to management. Use data-driven approaches to improve marketing effectiveness. 13. Culture & Values Ambassador Promote Kidzonia's values of care, creativity, learning, respect, and professionalism. Ensure marketing communications accurately reflect the organization's child-centric approach. Support initiatives that enhance parent trust and strengthen the school's reputation. Maintain ethical and responsible marketing practices suitable for early childhood education. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or related field. Master's Degree in Marketing, Management, or Business Administration preferred. Professional certifications in Digital Marketing will be an added advantage. Experience 812 years of marketing experience. Minimum 3–5 years in a leadership or managerial role. Prior experience in: Preschool / School / Education Sector (Preferred) Retail, Healthcare, Hospitality, or Service Industry Marketing Proven experience in admissions-driven marketing and lead generation is desirable. Key Skills & Competencies Strategic Marketing Planning Digital Marketing & Performance Marketing Brand Management Lead Generation & Conversion Management Event Planning & Community Outreach Budgeting & ROI Analysis Vendor & Agency Management Team Leadership & People Management Data Analysis & Reporting Strong Communication and Presentation Skills Relationship Building & Negotiation Skills Personal Attributes Creative and innovative thinker. Strong leadership and decision-making abilities. Highly organized and result-oriented. Proactive and solution-focused. Strong business acumen. Passion for education and child development. Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-center environment. Working Conditions Full-time, on-site role. Travel to centers is mandatory. May require working during admission drives, events, school functions, and promotional activities. Regular interaction with parents, children, staff, vendors, agencies, and community stakeholders. Availability for occasional weekend events and marketing campaigns as required.

description:
Kiwi Automation Private Limited is a technology-driven company providing digital solutions, software development, web and mobile application development, automation, and digital marketing services. We help businesses grow through innovative technology solutions and result-oriented digital strategies. We are looking for a passionate and performance-driven Performance Marketing Specialist who can plan, execute, manage, and optimise digital advertising campaigns to generate quality leads, increase conversions, and maximise ROI. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook Instagram), and other digital advertising platforms. Develop performance marketing strategies to generate high-quality leads and drive business growth. Manage Google Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, and Meta lead generation campaigns. Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, competitor analysis, and campaign planning. Create and optimise ad copies, creatives, landing pages, and campaign funnels. Monitor campaign performance, budgets, CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, ROAS, and conversion rates. Continuously optimise campaigns to improve performance and reduce customer acquisition costs. JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Technical Growth Officer 
 Position Overview 
The Technical Growth Officer will be responsible for generating business through technical sales, site visits, customer development, product demonstrations, technical support, and project lead generation .
The role combines technical knowledge with business development and requires the employee to understand customer/site requirements, recommend suitable products and systems, coordinate with internal technical teams, and support the conversion of enquiries into orders.
The Technical Growth Officer will primarily work in the field and develop relationships with customers, contractors, applicators, architects, consultants, builders, developers, industries, and project teams .

 1. Position Details 
 ParticularDetailsDesignation Technical Growth Officer Department Technical Growth / Business Development Reporting To Senior Technical Growth Officer / Project Growth Manager Experience 15 Years Location Assigned Territory Job Type Full-Time Travel Regular field/site travel Industry Preference Waterproofing / Industrial Coatings / Epoxy Flooring / PU Flooring / Construction Chemicals / Technical Sales
 2. Primary Objective 
To generate qualified technical business opportunities, understand customer requirements, provide suitable technical solutions, and support the sales team in converting opportunities into profitable orders.
 Core Responsibility 
 Lead Generation Customer Visit Site Inspection Requirement Understanding Product Recommendation Technical Presentation Quotation Support Follow-Up Order Conversion 

 3. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Technical Business Development 
 Generate new leads through field visits and technical networking. Identify customers requiring waterproofing, flooring, coatings, and construction chemical solutions. Understand customer problems and recommend suitable solutions. Support the sales team with technical inputs. Develop new customers within the assigned territory. Generate project and industrial leads. Identify opportunities for repeat and additional business. Maintain a continuous pipeline of technical opportunities. 
 4. Lead Generation 
Generate leads through:
 Direct market visits Industrial visits Construction sites Contractors Applicators Architects Consultants Builders and developers Existing customers References Dealers/distributors Exhibitions Website enquiries IndiaMART/B2B portals Digital marketing leads All qualified leads must be entered into the company's CRM/system.

 5. Site Visit & Requirement Assessment 
 Visit customer/project sites. Understand site conditions and customer requirements. Identify waterproofing, flooring, coating, leakage, corrosion, insulation, or construction chemical requirements. Take site measurements and photographs where required. Collect technical information. Identify application challenges. Discuss initial technical solutions with the customer. Prepare site visit reports. Coordinate with Senior Technical/Technical Team for complex requirements. 
 6. Product & System Knowledge 
The Technical Growth Officer should develop working knowledge of company products and systems such as:
 Waterproofing 
 PU waterproofing Cementitious waterproofing Crystalline waterproofing Waterproofing membranes Terrace waterproofing Basement waterproofing Joint and crack treatment Flooring 
 Epoxy flooring PU flooring Self-leveling flooring Heavy-duty industrial flooring Anti-skid flooring Protective Coatings 
 Anti-corrosion coatings Industrial protective coatings Heat-insulation coatings Fire-retardant coatings Electrical insulation coatings Construction Chemicals 
 Tile adhesives Epoxy grouts Sealants Repair products Bonding agents Surface treatment products The employee must understand where, why, and how each product/system is used.

 7. Technical Product Presentation 
 Explain product features and applications to customers. Conduct basic technical presentations. Explain product benefits and application procedures. Provide technical datasheets and product information. Conduct product demonstrations when required. Coordinate sample and trial applications. Explain the difference between company systems and competitor solutions. Support product awareness activities. 
 8. Consultant & Architect Visits 
 Visit architects and consultants regularly. Introduce company products and systems. Explain technical applications. Provide product literature and technical documents. Identify specification opportunities. Understand upcoming projects. Develop long-term technical relationships. Maintain consultant visit records. 
 9. Contractor & Applicator Development 
 Identify active contractors and applicators. Develop relationships with them. Understand their project requirements. Introduce suitable products and systems. Coordinate product demonstrations and training. Generate leads through contractor networks. Support contractors during initial product application. Maintain contractor database. 
 10. Customer Handling 
 Conduct regular customer meetings. Understand customer technical and commercial requirements. Provide initial technical guidance. Coordinate with senior technical personnel where required. Maintain professional communication. Follow up after site visits and technical discussions. Collect customer feedback. Identify additional business opportunities. 
 11. Technical Coordination 
Coordinate with:
 Customer Sales Technical Team R&D Estimation Project Team 
Responsibilities include:
 Sharing site information. Sharing customer requirements. Coordinating site inspections. Arranging samples. Coordinating product trials. Supporting technical approvals. Providing technical inputs for quotations. Supporting project handover. Escalating technical issues. 
 12. Quotation Support 
 Understand basic project requirements and BOQ. Provide technical information to the estimation/commercial team. Support preparation of quotations. Ensure the correct product/system is quoted. Follow up on quotations. Coordinate quotation revisions. Inform senior team members about customer feedback and competitor pricing. Support the sales team during negotiations. 
 13. Lead Follow-Up & Conversion 
The employee must maintain strict follow-up on every qualified opportunity.
 Follow-up process: 
 Lead 

 Qualification 

 Customer Meeting 

 Site Visit 

 Technical Requirement 

 Product Recommendation 

 Sample/Trial 

 Quotation 

 Follow-Up 

 Order 
Every opportunity must have a defined next action and expected timeline .

 14. Business Growth Responsibilities 
The Technical Growth Officer is not only a technical support role.
The employee is expected to:
 Generate new business leads. Develop new customers. Generate project enquiries. Support technical approvals. Develop consultants and contractors. Generate product trials. Convert enquiries into orders. Support achievement of sales targets. Generate repeat business. Cross-sell and up-sell suitable products. 
 15. Project Support 
 Identify project opportunities. Collect project information. Coordinate with project sales teams. Support site inspections. Provide technical inputs. Support product trials. Assist in technical meetings. Support project handover after order confirmation. Assist project teams in resolving initial technical queries. 
 16. Customer Complaint Support 
 Understand customer complaints related to product/application. Visit the site when required. Collect photographs and technical information. Report the issue to the senior technical team. Coordinate corrective action. Follow up until resolution. Maintain complaint records. Communicate professionally with customers. 
 17. Daily Field Activity 
The employee is expected to maintain productive field activity including:
 Customer visits Site visits Contractor meetings Consultant meetings Architect meetings New project identification Lead generation Technical presentations Product demonstrations Product trials Quotation follow-ups Business follow-ups Activity quality, lead quality, conversion, and revenue contribution will be evaluatednot only the number of visits. 

 18. CRM & Reporting 
 100% CRM/reporting discipline is mandatory. 
The employee must update:
 New leads Customer information Project details Site visits Technical requirements Product recommendations Samples Trials Quotations Follow-ups Expected order date Expected order value Competitor information Lost opportunity reasons Order status Complaint status Daily Report 
 Customer meetings Site visits New leads Technical discussions Follow-ups Quotations Expected business Weekly Report 
 Lead pipeline Project opportunities Target vs. achievement Site visit summary Consultant development Contractor development Product trials Conversion status Pending technical issues Next-week action plan 
 19. KPI & Performance Measurement 
 KPIMeasurementSales/Revenue Contribution Target vs. Actual Technical Leads Qualified leads generated New Customers New active customers Project Leads Qualified projects identified Site Visits Productive visits Customer Meetings Productive meetings Technical Presentations Presentations conducted Product Trials Trials conducted & converted Quotation Conversion Quotations converted into orders Consultant Development Active consultant relationships Contractor Development Active contractor relationships Repeat Business Repeat order value Complaint Resolution Timely technical support CRM Compliance 100% timely reporting Follow-Up Discipline All qualified leads followed up
 20. Required Technical Skills 
The candidate should have basic-to-good knowledge of:
 Waterproofing systems Epoxy flooring PU flooring Industrial coatings Anti-corrosion coatings Construction chemicals Surface preparation Crack/joint treatment Application methodology BOQ basics Site inspection Basic estimation Technical documentation 
 21. Required Business Skills 
 Lead generation Technical sales Customer acquisition Field sales Project business development Follow-up Negotiation Customer relationship management Basic commercial understanding Business conversion 
 22. Required Personal Competencies 
 Strong communication Good technical understanding Positive attitude Target-oriented Proactive approach Strong follow-up Ownership mindset Good presentation skills Problem-solving ability Willingness to travel Good reporting discipline Team coordination Professional customer handling 
 23. Educational Qualification 
Preferred:
 Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Construction Technology, or related field . Additional qualification in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage. 
 24. Experience 
Preferred:
 15 years of experience Technical sales/business development experience preferred. Fresh Civil Engineering candidates with strong communication and field-sales aptitude may also be considered. Experience in waterproofing, flooring, industrial coatings, construction chemicals, or related industries will be an advantage. 
 25. Ideal Candidate Profile 
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented technical professional with a strong interest in business development .
The candidate should be:
 Technically curious Strong in customer interaction Comfortable visiting sites Good at understanding customer problems Good at explaining technical solutions Strong in follow-up Target-oriented Willing to travel Proactive in generating leads Good at building contractor/consultant relationships Capable of learning products quickly Focused on converting technical interactions into business 
 26. Career Progression

 Senior Technical Growth Officer

 Senior Project Growth Manager 

 Regional Growth & Operations Head State 

 Zonal Growth & Operations Head 

 Chief Growth Officer 

 PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITY 
 The Technical Growth Officer is responsible for creating business opportunities through technical knowledge and field engagement. 
 Lead Generation + Site Visits + Technical Assessment + Product Recommendation + Customer/Consultant/Contractor Development + Product Demonstration + Quotation Support + Follow-Up + Order Conversion + Project Support 
The role must focus on both technical excellence and business generation . Every site visit and technical interaction should contribute toward building the sales pipeline and generating measurable business.

description: Role Overview The Head of Marketing will be responsible for developing and leading the overall marketing strategy for Living Concepts across Brand, Digital, Performance Marketing, Retail, Franchise, B2B, Content, Influencer Marketing, CRM and Customer Acquisition. The role will combine strategic thinking, brand leadership, performance orientation and team management, with a strong focus on translating marketing investments into measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate should have experience building and scaling a consumer-facing brand, preferably in Furniture, Home Dcor, Lifestyle, Retail, D2C or a related category. Key Responsibilities 1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth Develop and implement the overall annual and long-term marketing strategy. Align marketing objectives with the company's revenue, retail expansion, franchise and B2B growth objectives. Develop annual, quarterly and monthly marketing plans. Identify new customer acquisition and brand-building opportunities. Establish clear marketing KPIs and performance benchmarks. Build a balance between short-term performance marketing and long-term brand building. 2. Brand Strategy & Positioning Own the overall Living Concepts brand strategy and positioning. Strengthen the brand's differentiation within the premium furniture market. Establish and maintain brand tone, messaging and communication principles. Ensure consistency of brand identity across digital, retail, B2B, franchise and offline touchpoints. Lead brand-building initiatives and integrated campaigns. Develop long-term brand equity and consumer relevance. 3. Campaign & Communication Strategy Lead the concept utilization of integrated marketing campaigns. Develop campaign themes, communication territories and promotional strategies. Oversee seasonal, festive, product-led and offer-led campaigns. Develop go-to-market strategies for new collections and products. Ensure campaigns have clearly defined objectives, target audiences and measurable outcomes. 4. Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition Own the overall performance marketing strategy across Meta, Google and other relevant platforms. Set acquisition targets and performance benchmarks. Identify opportunities for optimisation and scale. Build an effective Lead Walk-in Booking Revenue funnel in collaboration with Sales and Retail. 5. Retail Marketing Develop the marketing strategy for existing and upcoming retail stores. Drive marketing initiatives aimed at increasing store awareness, walk-ins and conversions. Develop local/store-level marketing strategies. Support new store launches with integrated marketing campaigns. Work closely with retail teams to understand customer behaviour and store performance. Develop retail events, activations and customer engagement initiatives. 6. Franchise Marketing Develop marketing support for franchise acquisition and expansion. Create strategies to generate qualified franchise enquiries. Develop franchise marketing communication and campaigns. Work closely with the business development/franchise team to create marketing-led opportunities. Track franchise marketing performance and lead quality. 7. B2B Marketing Develop and lead the B2B marketing strategy. Build communication for architects, interior designers, dealers, hospitality and institutional clients. Develop B2B campaigns, events and engagement initiatives. Strengthen the brand's presence within the professional design and furniture ecosystem. Work closely with the B2B sales team to support business development. 8. Content & Social Media Define the overall content strategy across platforms. Establish content pillars and communication priorities. Oversee social media strategy and agency execution. Drive product storytelling, craftsmanship, factory, design and lifestyle content. Develop video-first and content-led brand initiatives. Ensure social media contributes to both brand building and business objectives. 9. Influencer, Partnership & Collaboration Marketing Develop the overall influencer and partnership strategy. Identify relevant creators, designers, personalities and brand partners. Lead high-impact collaborations and integrated influencer campaigns. Evaluate influencer partnerships based on brand fit, reach, engagement and business outcomes. Develop strategic partnerships that strengthen brand visibility and relevance. 10. Product & Catalogue Marketing Develop go-to-market strategies for new products and collections. Establish product positioning, USPs and communication. Oversee product photography, renders, videos and catalogue development. Ensure product communication is consistent with the brand strategy. Work closely with Product, Design, Sales and Retail teams. 11. CRM & Customer Lifecycle Marketing Develop the overall CRM and customer communication strategy. Establish customer segmentation and targeted communication. Oversee WhatsApp, email and other direct marketing initiatives. Develop remarketing and customer retention strategies. Identify opportunities to improve repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. 12. Agency & Vendor Management Lead relationships with external marketing agencies and specialist vendors. Define agency scopes, KPIs and deliverables. Review agency performance and commercial effectiveness. Oversee marketing spends and agency budgets. Evaluate agency performance against business outcomes. Lead agency selection, onboarding and performance reviews where required. 13. Marketing Analytics, Reporting & ROI Establish a comprehensive marketing reporting framework. Monitor marketing spends, leads, walk-ins, bookings, revenue and ROI. Analyse the complete marketing funnel. Identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions. Develop dashboards and management reports. Present marketing performance and strategic recommendations to management. 14. Team Leadership Build and lead a high-performing marketing team. Define roles, responsibilities and KPIs. Establish marketing processes and workflows. Mentor and develop team members. Coordinate effectively across Marketing, Sales, Retail, Product and Management. Build a culture of accountability, creativity and performance. 15. Market & Consumer Intelligence Monitor market trends and evolving consumer preferences. Conduct competitor and category analysis. Identify emerging opportunities within the furniture and lifestyle market. Develop customer insights to inform marketing strategy. Track competitor communication, campaigns, pricing and positioning. Key Performance Indicators The role will be evaluated against a combination of brand, marketing and business metrics, including: Marketing-generated revenue Lead quality and volume Qualified leads Store walk-ins Lead-to-walk-in conversion Walk-in-to-booking conversion Customer acquisition cost Cost per qualified lead ROAS / marketing ROI Retail store performance Franchise lead generation B2B lead generation Digital and social growth Brand awareness and engagement Campaign performance Marketing budget utilisation Agency performance Candidate Profile Required Experience 1218+ years of experience in Marketing, preferably with significant experience in a leadership role. Experience managing external agencies and internal marketing teams. Proven experience managing substantial marketing budgets. Strong understanding of retail and customer acquisition funnels. Experience managing integrated campaigns across digital and offline channels. title: Account Manager Digital Strategy & Servicing
description:
About the Role Webenza is looking for an Account Manager to independently lead the digital mandate for one of our most significant accounts a leading B2B construction solutions company with a portfolio of professional-grade brands spanning waterproofing, adhesives, tile fixing, and surface solutions. 
 This is not a coordinator role. You will own the client relationship, drive integrated digital strategy, and lead cross-functional execution across social media, performance marketing, SEO, content, and creative while holding accountability for delivery quality and business outcomes. 
 The ideal candidate understands that B2B client servicing is fundamentally different from B2C the audiences are professional (contractors, applicators, architects, dealers, developers), the communication requires functional credibility, and the brand demands precision over flair. 
 What You'll Be Managing 
 The account spans multiple sub-brands, each with distinct audience segments and communication needs: Professional trade audiences: Contractors, applicators, site supervisors Specification influencers: Architects, interior designers, project consultants Channel: Dealers, distributors, and trade partners Developer & builder segment: Real estate developers, infrastructure leads, and commercial builders 
 Mandates include: Brand social media, campaign execution, influencer and on-ground activations, SEO, performance marketing coordination, website and VSE (virtual sales enabler) management, exhibition and event support, and leadership reporting. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Client Management & Strategic Ownership Independently manage the account with minimal supervision own the relationship, the roadmap, and the results. Translate client business objectives (penetration, loyalty, specification pull-through) into integrated digital plans. Drive client conversations beyond task updates toward campaign performance, audience insights, and growth opportunities. Handle escalations with ownership and composure. 
 Integrated Execution Oversee delivery across social media, performance marketing, SEO, creative, content, website, and production. Ensure briefs are tight, outputs are on-brand, and timelines are non-negotiable. Coordinate across Creative, Copy, SEO, Performance, Tech, and Production teams with clarity and process discipline.
 
 B2B Communication Sensibility Understand the nuance of marketing to professional audiences functional proof points matter more than aspiration. Maintain brand voice consistency across a multi-brand portfolio where tone, hierarchy, and audience vary significantly. Be comfortable with long-format content, technical product communication, and trade-facing campaigns alongside brand work. 
 Project & Process Management Own trackers, WIPs, MoMs, billing workflows, and delivery governance. Proactively surface risks before they become client problems. Contribute to improving internal SOPs and delivery efficiency.
 Performance & Reporting Interpret campaign metrics across social, paid, and SEO and present them with strategic recommendations, not just numbers. Build reporting cadences suited to different stakeholders: marketing teams, sales teams, and senior leadership. 
 Team Leadership Guide and mentor junior servicing team members. Raise briefing quality and internal communication standards across the team. 
 What We're Looking For 4-6 years in client servicing or account management within a digital or integrated agency. Prior exposure to B2B accounts, trade or professional audiences, or construction/building materials - a strong advantage. Solid understanding of social media marketing; functional understanding of performance marketing, SEO, and creative workflows. Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong process discipline - trackers, timelines, and documentation are not afterthoughts. Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before escalation. Comfortable with both structured deliverable-heavy projects and creatively driven campaigns. Active user of AI tools - for briefing, reporting, content drafts, and campaign analysis with a genuine efficiency mindset 
 Why Join Webenza Lead a flagship B2B account with real strategic depth. Exposure across social, SEO, performance, creative, exhibitions, and consulting. Direct growth path into larger strategic and leadership responsibilities. High-ownership culture that values thinking over hierarchy. AI-first environment where tools are genuinely integrated into how we work.

description:
General Manager Cross-Border Healthcare Company: VitaFly Consulting FZE
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 3 To 6 Years
 Locations: Mumbai, Delhi, Dubai, Geneva, Lagos, Abuja, Nairobi
 Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid Compensation: Competitive compensation, commensurate with the candidates experience, skills, and expertise. Compensation is negotiable for exceptional candidates 
 Job Summary We are looking for a hands-on General Manager to lead business development, strategic partnerships, and operational coordination for a growing cross-border healthcare business. The role focuses on connecting patients, referring doctors, hospitals, insurers, and healthcare partners to facilitate access to quality and affordable international medical treatment. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and cross-functional teams to expand referral networks, develop hospital partnerships, improve patient coordination, and drive the adoption of a technology-enabled healthcare platform. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Healthcare Business Development & Partnerships Develop and manage relationships with doctors, hospitals, clinics, insurers, corporates, healthcare facilitators, and other referral partners. Drive patient referrals and build strategic partnerships across priority markets, particularly in Africa. Support partnership negotiations, agreements, onboarding, and ongoing engagement. Collaborate with digital marketing teams to support patient acquisition and business growth. 
 2. International Patient Management & Operations Oversee international patient journeys, from initial enquiries and treatment planning to travel, treatment, and post-treatment follow-up. Coordinate medical quotations, patient approvals, visa documentation, travel arrangements, accommodation, hospital coordination, insurance approvals, billing, and payments. Establish efficient workflows, service standards, and escalation mechanisms. Step in directly to resolve complex patient cases and operational challenges when required. 
 3. Hospital Network Development Expand and manage partnerships with hospitals across India, Trkiye, the UAE, Thailand, and other approved destinations. Coordinate hospital onboarding, commercial agreements, treatment quotations, and information collection. Work with hospitals, patients, and referring doctors to obtain treatment plans and necessary clarifications. Ensure clear documentation of patient cases, payment processes, and commercial arrangements. 
 4. Digital Healthcare Platform Adoption Work with product and technology teams to improve a digital platform supporting patients, hospitals, doctors, insurers, and healthcare partners. Provide operational feedback, participate in platform testing, and follow up on agreed development priorities. Onboard pilot partners and encourage active platform usage to increase patient referrals. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology. 
 5. Business Growth & Strategy Research new markets, healthcare services, and partnership opportunities. Support initiatives such as surgical camps, telemedicine services, post-treatment care, and insurance-focused healthcare solutions. Evaluate pilot projects and recommend opportunities for expansion. Support the implementation of business growth initiatives across international markets. 
 6. Team Management & Reporting Coordinate internal teams and external partners across multiple countries. Track patient cases, referral partnerships, hospital onboarding, and business development activities. Report performance, operational challenges, and key risks to the CEO. title: Deputy Manager E-Commerce
description:
The organisation is seeking a highly analytical, data-driven, and technically proficient Manager, Performance Analytics & CRM Intelligence. The role requires complete ownership of data ingestion pipelines, CRM transformations, API integrations, funnel analytics, and performance insights that directly impact ROI and revenue. This is a deeply technical, analytical position for a specialist who can translate large volumes of Ads, CRM, and Customer Journey data into actionable insights. You will manage attribution systems, build automated dashboards, build lead-scoring and propensity models, and influence creative, landing page, and audience strategy through UI/UX intelligence. You will play a central role in ensuring that all digital signals - from Ads platforms to CRM- are stitched end-to-end, enabling the team to make fast, precise, and revenue-anchored decisions. Key Responsibilities: 1. Data Analysis & Ingestion Pipelines Data Ingestion Ownership: Build, maintain, and optimise ingestion pipelines from Google Ads, Meta Ads, publishers, CRM, and internal databases. API Integrations: Manage and coordinate API connectors with 3P vendors and internal teams to ensure real-time data flows into dashboards, CRM tables, and audience systems. Signal Accuracy: Ensure accurate mapping of UTM parameters, source tracking, event tagging, and CRM disposition codes. Data Cleaning & Validation: Build processes to clean, standardise, and quality-check incoming lead and campaign data. 2. CRM Intelligence & Funnel Analytics Dynamics 365 Expertise: Own the analytics layer in Dynamics CRMmonitor routing, conversion stages, timestamp hygiene, and funnel drop-offs. Funnel Diagnostics: Conduct deep analytics across the full funnel: Impression Click Lead QL Opportunity Sale Revenue. Lead Quality Analysis: Build frameworks to identify junk lead patterns and correlate them with campaign, audience, and publisher parameters. Sales Feedback Loop: Integrate Sales/Call Centre disposition data into performance dashboards and trigger optimisation recommendations. 3. Measurement Infrastructure & Attribution GA4 & GTM Management: Own tagging, tracking, and event schema for all digital assets, ensuring flawless signal flow from web CRM reporting systems. Attribution Models: Create multi-touch and first-touch attribution views, aligned with business-specific KPIs. CAPI Integrations: Maintain Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions, offline conversions, and server-to-server integrations. 4. Predictive Modelling & Performance Scoring Lead Scoring Models: Build scoring frameworks using ad intent signals, CRM fields, landing page behaviours, and call outcomes. Propensity Modelling: Construct propensity models to predict likelihood of conversion by campaign, audience, publisher, and product. Forecasting & Trend Modelling: Use historical analytics to forecast spend efficiency, lead volumes, and product-specific sales trends. 5. Creative, Landing Page & Audience Intelligence UI/UX Optimisation: Analyse landing page behaviours (scroll depth, form drops, bounce patterns) to recommend UI/UX improvements. Creative Intelligence: Provide insights on creative hooks, messaging patterns, and audience resonance based on CRM & funnel data. Audience Architecture: Build high-intent platform audiences using CRM segments, lookalikes, retargeting clusters, and product behaviour cohorts. 6. Reporting, Automation & Insights Dashboarding: Build automated dashboards in Power BI, Looker Studio, and Excel that visualise Spend Leads QLs Sales ROAS Revenue. Automation: Implement automated triggers for anomaly detection (CPL spikes, lead quality dips, publisher issues). Insights & Recommendations: Provide daily, weekly, and monthly insights that shape campaign direction, targeting, and creative strategy. Candidate Profile: 1. Technical Expertise Analytics & Data Tools: 47 years of experience with Power BI, Looker Studio, GA4, GTM, SQL (preferred), Python/R (optional). CRM Systems: Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Salesforce, specifically with routing tables, disposition codes, and automation flows. API & Integrations: Hands-on experience with API connectors, webhooks, server-side integrations, and ETL processes. Advanced Measurement: Experience with CAPI, offline conversions, enhanced conversions, and multi-touch attribution. AI Literacy: Ability to use AI tools for modelling, data cleaning, analysis, creative recommendations, and insight generation. 2. Experience & Skills Proven background managing performance analytics in high-volume lead-generation setups (BFSI preferred). Strong command over data modelling, signal hygiene, funnel optimisation, and attribution science. Ability to convert complex datasets into simple, actionable insights for media, sales, and product teams. Fast problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify root causes and recommend fixes instantly. title: AI-First Digital Marketer
description:
Being found where buyers actually look 
 Systematize and multiply our founder-led thought leadership on LinkedIn, where individual profiles carry several times the reach of company pages. You run the engine behind it: research, drafts for approval, timing, repurposing, measurement. Own our visibility in AI answers. When ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Googles AI Overviews are asked about our categories, Allerin gets cited. Search still matters; do it the 2026 way, for AI Overviews and assistants as much as for the classic ten blue links. 
 
 Content as proof 
 Turn real engineering work into the content that sells it: case studies with real numbers, technical write-ups, original data and benchmarks. The content is the product demo. Build the repurposing engine: one webinar or project story becomes clips, posts, a write-up, and an email, in hours and not weeks. Guard the voice. AI drafts; you edit; nothing generic ships. 
 
 The machine 
 Build and own the marketing workflows: automation platforms, enrichment and outbound tooling, automated reporting, and AI agents working under guardrails you define. Run small-volume, high-relevance outbound: AI-researched named accounts, sequences coordinated with what we are publishing, never spray and pray. Keep measurement honest: first-party tracking done properly, CRM-based pipeline attribution, and the discipline to ask "how did you hear about us". 
 
 Outcomes, not output 
 Your numbers are qualified conversations with the right enterprises, engagement of named target accounts, citations in AI answers for our categories, and marketing-sourced pipeline. Followers, impressions, and post likes are not outcomes here, and we will not pretend they are. Say plainly what is working, what is not, and what you are testing next, every week. 
 
 This role is not for you if 
 Your core skill is managing a posting schedule. The tools do that now. You measure yourself in impressions and followers. You list AI tools on your resume but cannot show a workflow you built. You ship AI output without editing it, or cannot tell when it is wrong. You need an agency and a big budget before anything can happen. You think B2B marketing means boosting posts and collecting MQLs. You need a team to hide in. This function is you, with leverage.

title: E-Commerce & Marketplace Executive
description:
About Toothsi 
 Toothsi is makeO's oral care brand. It started in 2018 with clear aligners delivered through 29 owned clinics and a home-scan model, and now sells an oral care range built around aligner care: Foamy aligner cleaner, whitening kits and pens, water flossers, chewies and toothpaste. 
 Products sell on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website and through our clinics. Quick commerce is the next channel we open. makeO Healthcare Technologies is ISO 13485:2016 certified. 
 The role 
 You will own Toothsi's growth on Amazon and on quick commerce. Our products are already on Amazon through our own seller account and a distributor partner, and we are about to launch on Blinkit, with Zepto and Instamart to follow. The job is to make these channels grow: get us live and visible, keep stock flowing, run the ads and deals, launch the new products and bundles, and read the numbers every week to decide what to push next. The Head of E-commerce sets the plan and the targets; you drive them and own the results. 


 1. What you will do 

 Channel growth: Amazon and quick commerce 
 Own the monthly sales target for each channel and the plan to hit it: assortment, availability, visibility, price and promotions. Take Toothsi live on Blinkit and then Zepto and Instamart, and scale from the first SKU to the full range: onboarding, catalogue, dark-store availability, replenishment cadence, platform promotions and category placements. Grow Amazon: search rank, conversion, Buy Box, deals and coupons, festival events (Great Indian Festival, Diwali) and the distributor's assortment. Launch new products, bundles and multipacks on every channel, fast and complete, and push them until they sell. 
 Marketplace operations 
 Run the accounts end to end: Amazon (Vendor Central and Seller Central), Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Flipkart and Myntra. Accept and process purchase orders from marketplaces and from our distributor partner; check stock with the inventory team before confirming; chase fill rate; make sure every PO ships on time and in full. Be the single point of contact for platform account managers, marketplace support and our distributor's day-to-day questions; close issues, do not park them. 
 Listings, pricing and stock health 
 Watch in-stock status on every live listing and dark store and flag a stock-out risk before it happens. Monitor prices, Buy Box ownership and unauthorised sellers daily; hold our price floors and raise any promotion that has not been approved. Keep listings complete and correct: titles, bullets, images, A+ content, category nodes, variations. Track ratings and reviews, run review programmes (Vine, follow-ups) and escalate quality issues. 
 Advertising and promotions 
 Run Amazon Ads, Myntra Ads and quick-commerce sponsored placements within the agreed budget: campaign set-up, keyword and bid hygiene, negatives, weekly optimisation against ACoS and sales targets. Plan the deal and coupon calendar per channel with the Head of E-commerce and execute it. 
 Reporting 
 Own the weekly channel scoreboard: sales vs target by SKU and channel, availability, Buy Box share, sell-through vs PO, ad spend and ACoS, ratings. Come to the weekly review with the three things to push next. 





 What good looks like in the first 90 days. 
 Blinkit is live, the first SKU is selling and Blinkit has invited the next ones. Amazon sales are growing month on month on the top listings, with the Buy Box held and price floors intact. Every open marketplace and distributor PO is tracked in one place and dispatched on time. The weekly scoreboard goes out every Monday without being asked for, with a clear ask for the week. 





 2. Who fits 

 Must-have 
 At least 2 years of hands-on work growing a D2C or FMCG brand on Amazon and on at least one quick-commerce platform (Blinkit, Zepto or Instamart), at a brand, a distributor or an e-commerce agency. A growth track record you can show with numbers: a listing, category or channel you took from X to Y, and what you did to get there. You have personally worked in Seller Central or Vendor Central and in a quick-commerce partner portal; you have processed marketplace POs and handled dispatch coordination, not only listings. Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, clean flat-file uploads. Organised, follows up without being chased, writes clear short updates. Fluent in English and Hindi. Based in Mumbai and able to work from our office full-time. 
 Good to have 
 Vendor Central or B2B distributor experience (PO acceptance, ASN, chargebacks). Amazon Ads or quick-commerce ads hands-on experience or certification. Flipkart Seller Hub and Myntra Partner Portal. Oral care, personal care or beauty category background. Experience launching a new brand or category on quick commerce from zero.

title: Experiential Marketing Manager (Retail Activation & Campaigning)
description:
Function: Marketing
 Sub-Function: Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning)
 Designation: Manager / Deputy Manager Marketing
 Joining Location: Mumbai Andheri East
 Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC)
 Regional Responsibility: West Region, with oversight of North Region resources
 Reporting To: Senior Manager Marketing & VM
 Experience: 7+ years, preferably 89 years
 Qualification: Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing Role Overview The Manager / Deputy Manager – Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning) will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing experiential marketing, retail activation, and consumer engagement initiatives across the West region. The role will play a key part in translating brand and marketing strategies into impactful retail campaigns and on-ground consumer experiences that strengthen brand awareness, increase store engagement and support business and sales objectives. In addition to managing marketing activation initiatives for the West region, the role will also be responsible for coordinating with and overseeing the deliverables of marketing resources supporting the North region , providing direction, guidance, and mentorship to ensure consistency in execution, timelines, and brand standards. The incumbent will work closely with the Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, Sales, Creative, Digital, and external agency teams to ensure seamless planning and execution of campaigns, events, activations, and other consumer-facing initiatives. Key Responsibilities 1. Retail Activation & Experiential Marketing Strategy Support the development and execution of regional experiential marketing and retail activation strategies aligned with overall brand and business objectives. Translate national marketing campaigns and brand priorities into relevant regional and local market activation plans. Identify opportunities to enhance consumer engagement through innovative retail experiences, events, activations, and localized campaigns. Develop activation concepts that are relevant to the target consumer and aligned with the brand's positioning. Ensure all regional activations maintain consistency with brand guidelines and communication standards. Recommend new and innovative activation formats based on market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive activity. 2. Campaign Planning & Execution Plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing campaigns across retail, experiential, events, print, digital and other relevant channels. Own regional campaign calendars and ensure timely execution of planned marketing initiatives. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies/vendors for campaign planning and execution. Prepare detailed campaign briefs, execution plans, timelines, and deliverables. Monitor campaign implementation from conceptualization through execution and closure. Ensure all campaign assets, branding elements and communication materials are delivered within agreed timelines. Conduct post-campaign reviews and identify opportunities for improvement. 3. Retail Store Activation Partner with Retail Operations and Sales teams to identify opportunities for increasing customer footfall, engagement, and conversion through localized activations. Develop and execute store-level promotional activities, consumer engagement programs, and local marketing initiatives. Support new store launches, store anniversaries, key retail moments and other business-critical initiatives. Develop activation plans for high-priority stores, malls, markets, and catchment areas. Ensure activation activities are aligned with store objectives and deliver measurable business impact. Gather feedback from stores and regional teams to continuously improve activation effectiveness. 4. Experiential Events, Partnerships & Sponsorships Plan and execute experiential events, consumer engagement activities, brand experiences, and promotional events. Identify and evaluate opportunities for relevant partnerships, sponsorships, collaborations, and local events. Coordinate with athletes, influencers, event partners, malls, retailers, and other external stakeholders where applicable. Manage event agencies and other external partners to ensure quality and timely execution. Ensure event experiences are consistent with brand identity and provide meaningful consumer engagement. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports with key learnings and recommendations. 5. Market & Consumer Research Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, retail trends, and competitor marketing activities. Conduct market scans to identify relevant opportunities for regional activations. Analyze competitor campaigns, events, promotions, and consumer engagement initiatives. Provide insights to the marketing team on regional consumer preferences and market opportunities. Use market intelligence to recommend localized marketing initiatives and improve campaign effectiveness. 6. Brand Management & Compliance Ensure consistent implementation of brand guidelines across all regional activations and consumer touchpoints. Work closely with creative and VM teams to ensure all campaign communication and physical branding elements meet brand standards. Review marketing collateral, activation concepts, and event branding before execution. Ensure agencies, vendors and other partners understand and adhere to brand requirements. Identify and address any gaps in brand execution across the region. 7. Creative & Content Coordination Work with internal creative teams and external agencies to develop campaign and activation communication. Prepare clear creative briefs covering campaign objectives, target audience, messaging, deliverables, and timelines. Coordinate development of promotional assets, event communication, retail communication, and digital content as required. Review creative outputs and provide relevant feedback to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines. Coordinate with digital and social media teams to amplify relevant retail activation and experiential initiatives. 8. Social Media & Digital Integration Coordinate with digital/social media teams to ensure relevant experiential and retail campaigns receive appropriate digital amplification. Support the development of content around events, activations, launches, and consumer engagement initiatives. Monitor campaign-related digital engagement and consumer response. Identify opportunities to integrate offline retail experiences with digital marketing initiatives. Ensure regional activation content is aligned with the overall digital communication strategy. 9. Collaboration with Sales & Retail Operations Work closely with Sales, Retail Operations and VM teams to understand regional business priorities and translate them into marketing activation plans. Support sales teams with relevant marketing initiatives that contribute to store traffic, consumer engagement, and sales. Participate in regional business reviews and provide marketing recommendations. Ensure marketing initiatives are planned based on store requirements, business priorities, and market potential. Establish strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of campaigns. 10. West Region Ownership Take end-to-end ownership of retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives for the West region. Develop regional activation plans based on business priorities, market potential, and consumer insights. Manage the regional marketing calendar and ensure timely execution. Coordinate with stores, regional business teams, agencies, and vendors. Monitor execution quality and ensure timely resolution of regional activation-related issues. Evaluate the effectiveness of regional initiatives and share actionable insights with the senior marketing team. 11. North Region Resource Oversight & Mentoring Provide functional guidance and mentorship to marketing resources supporting the North region. Review and monitor the North team's marketing activation plans, timelines, and deliverables. Ensure consistency in campaign execution, brand standards and reporting across West and North regions. Support North resources in campaign planning, agency coordination, event execution, and problem-solving. Review key deliverables and provide constructive feedback to improve quality and effectiveness. Act as a point of coordination between North regional resources and the central Marketing & VM team wherever required. Track progress against agreed deliverables and escalate critical gaps or delays to the reporting manager. Build capability within the North resources through regular guidance, knowledge sharing and best-practice sharing. 12. Agency & Vendor Management Identify, coordinate, and manage experiential marketing agencies, event agencies, production partners, and other vendors. Brief agencies clearly on campaign objectives, scope, timelines, and expected deliverables. Evaluate agency proposals and execution plans based on quality, relevance, feasibility, and cost. Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed timelines and deliverables. Ensure proper documentation and closure of marketing activities with external partners. Build strong agency/vendor relationships while maintaining commercial discipline. 13. Budget Management & Cost Optimization Support planning and management of regional marketing and activation budgets. Track campaign and activation spend against approved budgets. Ensure effective utilization of marketing spends and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Review vendor quotations and proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Maintain appropriate documentation for marketing spends approvals and campaign closures. Ensure activities are executed within approved financial parameters. 14. Campaign Performance & Reporting Establish relevant KPIs for retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives. Track campaign performance, consumer engagement, footfall, participation, and other relevant metrics. Prepare regular reports on campaign progress, spends, execution status and business impact. Conduct post-campaign analysis and identify key learnings. Provide actionable recommendations to improve future campaigns. Maintain a structured repository of campaign plans, reports, photographs, learnings, and performance data. 15. Cross-Functional Coordination Collaborate with Marketing, VM, Retail Operations, Sales, Digital, Creative, Finance and other internal stakeholders. Ensure effective communication of campaign requirements and timelines across functions. Coordinate multiple stakeholders simultaneously to ensure seamless campaign execution. Proactively identify execution challenges and drive timely resolution. Act as a strong bridge between the central marketing team and regional business teams. 
 Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have: 7+ years of relevant experience , preferably 8–9 years, in Marketing, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing, Brand Activation, Events or a related field. Prior experience in retail, consumer-facing, lifestyle, footwear, fashion, FMCG, consumer durables or other retail-oriented industries will be preferred. Strong hands-on experience in experiential marketing, retail activations, events, and campaign execution . Experience in managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong understanding of retail marketing and consumer engagement. Experience working with creative, experiential and event agencies. Ability to independently manage regional marketing initiatives from planning to execution and evaluation. Experience in mentoring or guiding junior/peer resources will be an advantage. Strong commercial understanding and ability to manage marketing budgets effectively. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment. Educational Qualification Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing from a recognized institute. Additional certification in Digital Marketing, Brand Management, Experiential Marketing or Event Management would be an advantage. Technical & Functional Skills Strong knowledge of Experiential Marketing and Retail Activation . Campaign planning and execution. Event management and consumer engagement. Agency and vendor management. Market and competitor analysis. Budget tracking and cost management. Campaign performance measurement and reporting. Strong understanding of retail marketing dynamics. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word . Strong presentation and report-making skills. Familiarity with digital marketing and social media platforms. Ability to interpret campaign data and derive actionable insights.

Key Skills: consumer engagement initiatives,retail activation,Brand Management,Creative & Content Coordination,experiential marketing,Digital Innovation,Marketing Management,Market Research

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing & Community Associate SkillUpExchange 
 25,000/month + performance bonus up to 35,000/quarter Full-time | In-office | Mumbai 
 Build relationships with technology professionals and help us build the distribution engine for a new technology publishing and learning company. 
 About SkillUpExchange 
 SkillUpExchange is building a new kind of technology publishing and learning company. 
 We work with experienced technology professionals and developers to create high-quality technical books, courses, audiobooks, and other learning products. 
 Our technology platform, AuthPlat , helps experts turn their knowledge into professionally produced technical content. SkillUpExchange is the consumer platform where these books and learning products are published, distributed, and connected with a broader technology learning community. 
 We are an early-stage company, which means you will not simply be executing an established marketing plan. You will help us build the plan and the processes themselves. 
 Our immediate focus is to build relationships with developers and technology professionals who can become readers, early learners, community members, advocates, course participants, and eventually even authors and instructors. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Marketing & Community Associate to help us build our technology community and distribution function. 
 This is a people + research + communication + execution role. A significant part of your day will involve identifying relevant technology professionals, researching their backgrounds and interests, reaching out to them through LinkedIn, starting conversations, introducing them to relevant books and learning products, and developing those relationships over time. 
 You will also work with our authors to build awareness for their books, support social media activity, develop partnerships with newsletters and technology creators, and maintain our growing community database. The role is particularly suited to someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, is curious about technology, and likes building things from scratch. 
 You do not need to be a software developer. You do need to be comfortable learning about technology and communicating with people who work in technology. 
 What You Will Do 1. Technology Community Outreach Identify relevant developers, engineers, technology professionals, technical leaders and technology enthusiasts on LinkedIn. Build relationships with approximately 40 relevant professionals per working day . Use the founder's LinkedIn network as well as your own professional network for outreach. Research people before contacting them and understand why a particular person may be relevant to a particular book or learning product. Send personalized introductory messages and follow up appropriately. Maintain conversations rather than treating outreach as a one-time activity. Invite relevant professionals to participate as early readers, community members, or learning participants. Build long-term relationships that can be useful across multiple books and products. 
 2. Community & Relationship Management You will maintain our relationship database in Zoho Bigin . You will record useful information such as: Who we have contacted Their role and company Technology interests Which books they may be interested in Conversations and responses Early-reader participation Course or learning interests Partnership opportunities Potential future author/instructor opportunities Follow-up dates and next actions The objective is not simply to generate contacts. Every relationship we create should make future distribution easier. 
 3. Author Support & Social Media Work with our authors to help them build awareness for their books. This will include: Preparing LinkedIn content ideas for authors. Creating approximately 2 posts per week for each active author . Giving authors content options they can review and approve. Coordinating publishing schedules. Reminding authors about scheduled posts. Helping authors turn their expertise, book launches and ideas into useful social content. Preparing content for SkillUpExchange, AuthPlat and the founder's LinkedIn presence. 
 4. Partnerships Research and develop relationships with people and organizations that already have audiences interested in technology. Potential partners include: Technology newsletters Technical bloggers YouTubers Podcasts Developer communities Technology educators Community organizers Relevant online publications You will build prospect lists, initiate conversations, and track partnerships from first contact through to publication or collaboration. 
 5. Measure, Learn & Improve Because we are an early-stage company, part of your job is to help us understand what actually works . You will track the journey from: People identified contacted connected responded interested read engaged became community members purchased/participated 
 You will review the results and help us improve our approach. We care about quality of relationships, not just the number of messages sent. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 You could be a great fit if you are: Curious about technology and enjoy learning new things. Naturally comfortable talking to people. Confident communicating with professionals and senior people. Strong in written and spoken English. Good at researching people and understanding what they do. Persistent without being pushy. Organized and consistent. Comfortable working with targets and measurable goals. Interested in LinkedIn and online communities. Comfortable using AI tools and learning new software. Ambitious and interested in taking ownership. Someone who enjoys building something from scratch. 
 You do NOT need: Prior publishing experience. A traditional marketing degree. Previous Developer Relations experience. To be a software developer. An MBA. Experience at a large technology company. 
 We are more interested in your curiosity, communication skills, initiative, and ability to build relationships than your degree or previous job title. 
 Who Would Be Especially Suitable? This role could be a particularly good fit for: Recent graduates in engineering, computer science or related fields. Students or graduates who are active in technology communities. People who enjoy LinkedIn and online networking. Candidates with strong communication skills who want to work in technology. Early-career candidates interested in marketing, community building, developer relations, technology publishing or technology business. Candidates who have organized college technology events, communities or clubs. People who enjoy meeting new people and starting conversations. 
 What Success Looks Like In your first few months, success will mean building a real and growing network of relevant technology professionals . You will be expected to contribute to: Growth of our developer and technology professional network. Early-reader participation for our books. Genuine Amazon reviews and reader feedback. LinkedIn visibility and author-generated content. Newsletter, creator and community partnerships. Growth of our CRM/community database. Better understanding of which outreach and distribution channels work. 
 The most important thing is that you help us move from: We have published a book. to “We know how to consistently find the right people to read it.” 
 Compensation & Benefits Salary 25,000 per month 
 Performance Bonus The role has a quarterly performance bonus of up to 35,000 , based on achievement against agreed distribution and community-building objectives. 
 Quarterly AchievementBonus Below 30%030–39%040–49%5,00050–59%10,00060–69%15,00070–79%20,00080–89%25,00090–99%30,000100%+ 35,000 
 Performance will consider both results and quality of execution . Spam, irrelevant outreach, misleading communication, or attempts to manipulate reviews will not qualify as successful performance. 
 Work Location & Schedule Location: Mumbai This is primarily an in-office role because you will work closely with the founder and the rest of the team while we build the distribution function. 
 Monday–Friday: Office 1st, 3rd and 5th Saturday: Working 2nd and 4th Saturday: Off Up to 2 WFH days per month 
 Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to join a company at a very early stage and help build an important function from the ground up. You will not be joining an established marketing department with a predefined process. 
 You will help us build: 
 technology publishing community distribution learning The role will give you exposure to: Technology marketing Community building Developer relations LinkedIn and social media Partnerships CRM and relationship management AI-assisted research and marketing Technology publishing Building distribution for a product from the ground up 
 As the company grows, this role can develop into broader responsibilities across Developer Relations, Community, Developer Programs, Technology Publishing and Author/Content Acquisition. If you are ambitious, curious about technology and enjoy building relationships with people, this is an opportunity to have a much larger impact than you would typically have in an entry-level role at a large company. 
 How to Apply 
 Please send your resume along with a short note explaining why you think you would be good at building relationships with technology professionals. 
 Candidates may also be asked to complete a short practical exercise involving: Finding relevant technology professionals for a technical book. Explaining why those people are relevant. Writing an introductory LinkedIn message. Thinking through how they would build a relationship with someone who responds. 
 We care more about how you think and communicate than about having the perfect resume.

 The role 
You will own every rupee of online revenue and every rupee of online ad spend. That means a growing monthly media budget across Amazon Ads, Flipkart PLA, Meta and Google, and an ambitious order target on a 40,000+ product.
This is a hands-on role, not a coordination role. You will be in Seller Central and Ads Manager daily. You will brief and hold an external creative agency to account. You will be measured on cost per order and net revenue not on impressions, reach or leads.
If you want a job where you forward agency reports to leadership, this is not it. If you want to own a P&L line and have the authority to move it, read on.
 What you will own 
 Marketplace performance 
• Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub end to end listings, A+ content, pricing, buy box, inventory health, returns and account metrics
• Amazon Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns; Flipkart PLA
• Firstcry channel for the Stormboy range
• Keyword research, listing optimisation and review management
 
 Paid media 
• Meta and Google campaigns on conversion objectives planning, execution and daily optimisation
• Managing our external creative agency: briefs, deadlines, quality control, performance accountability
• Budget pacing. We have overspent two months running. That stops with you.
 Website 
• Conversion rate on nexzu.in, including checkout health. We recently lost 1.8 lakh in cancelled orders to a checkout problem that is the kind of thing you find before we do.
• Product pages, EMI messaging, analytics and pixel integrity
 Data and reporting 
• One monthly reconciliation: spend, orders, cost per order, cancellations, returns, net revenue, blended CAC
• Weekly performance review with the founder
• Every number must tie out. We have had reports where the same campaign appeared twice and the ROAS did not reconcile with the stated spend. You will build reporting we can trust.
 Lead management 
• Meta lead campaigns generate volume we currently do not convert. You will build the follow-up process and own lead-to-order conversion.
 What we are looking for 
 Must have 
• 47 years in e-commerce or performance marketing, with at least 2 years hands-on in Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub
• Demonstrable P&L or CAC ownership you can talk through a channel you scaled and what it cost
• Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads at a working level, on conversion objectives
• Strong spreadsheet skills. You should be able to build a CAC model without being asked twice.
• Comfort holding an agency to account
 
 
 Strongly preferred 
• Experience with considered-purchase products above 20,000 where the funnel is long and EMI matters
• D2C, consumer durables, mobility, or EV category background
• GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API setup experience
• Working Hindi and Marathi alongside English
 Who fits 
• You are sceptical of your own numbers before anyone else is
• You would rather report a real CAC of 3,000 than a flattering ROAS you cannot defend
• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who owns this function
• You want to build the system, not inherit one
 Why this is worth your time 
• You will own a channel outright, reporting directly to the founder no layers, no committee
• Real budget authority from day one, scaling through the year
• A category with genuine tailwind, and a group that controls its own battery supply
• Performance-linked incentive tied to orders and CAC, not to activity
 How to apply 
Send your CV to hrd@nexzu.co.uk with a short note answering one question:
 You are given 1,00,000 a month to sell a 42,000 electric cycle. How would you deploy it, how many orders would you expect, and what do you measure in week one? 
Half a page is plenty. We care about how you think, not how you write.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Company Profile 
 Vissco Healthcare Pvt Ltd Established in 1963,is one of India's leading manufacturers of orthopaedic supports, rehabilitation products, mobility aids, and wellness solutions. With over six decades of expertise, Vissco is committed to improving mobility, enhancing recovery, and empowering people to lead active, independent lives through innovative and high-quality healthcare products. 
 Headquartered in Mumbai, Vissco has a strong presence across India and international markets, serving healthcare professionals, hospitals, retailers, and millions of customers worldwide. Driven by innovation, quality, and customer-centricity, Vissco continues to set benchmarks in the healthcare and medical devices industry. 
 Company Website: https://www.vissconext.com/ 

 Role Overview 
 The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing effective marketing and brand strategies to drive business growth, strengthen brand awareness, and enhance market positioning. The role involves market research, campaign planning and execution, promotional activities, budget management, performance analysis, team leadership, and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Marketing Strategy Development 
 Develop, implement, and monitor marketing strategies and policies in line with the organization's business objectives, market opportunities, and budgetary requirements. Market Research and Competitive Analysis 
 Conduct market surveys and research to understand market trends, size, growth opportunities, customer preferences, and competitive landscape. Analyze competitors strengths, weaknesses, strategies, and market positioning. Campaign Planning and Execution 
 Plan, execute, and monitor integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, traditional, and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness and business growth. Promotional Activities 
 Plan and implement promotional activities and customer engagement initiatives to encourage repeat business, support new product launches, and strengthen customer relationships. Budget Management 
 Manage marketing budgets effectively by allocating resources, monitoring expenses, and evaluating return on investment (ROI) to optimize marketing spend and achieve business objectives. Team Management 
 Lead, mentor, and supervise the marketing team by providing guidance, support, and direction to ensure effective execution of marketing initiatives. Brand Management and Consistency 
 Develop and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines and ensure consistency across all marketing and communication materials. Oversee the creation, distribution, and management of brand assets. Brand Growth and Development 
 Drive the overall growth and development of the Vissco brand by developing and implementing strategic brand initiatives that strengthen brand identity, increase market awareness and visibility, enhance brand positioning, and support long-term business growth. Performance Analysis and Optimization 
 Monitor and analyze the performance of marketing campaigns and initiatives. Identify areas for improvement and optimize strategies based on insights and performance metrics. Cross-Functional and External Collaboration 
 Collaborate with internal teams, including Sales, Product, and Creative teams, to align marketing initiatives with overall business objectives and ensure consistent brand communication. Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, and partners to leverage expertise, execute campaigns effectively, and maximize marketing impact. Content and Social Media Communication 
 Oversee and manage marketing communication initiatives, including newsletters, social media marketing, blog content, and other digital and brand communication activities. Training 
 Facilitating product training and development of the sales team.
